contract.profile_definition: per-window shape; 20bp bins are nonoverlapping sums
contract.js_distance: sqrt natural-log Jensen-Shannon divergence, matching scipy.spatial.distance.jensenshannon
contract.spearman_ci: point estimate only; block CI computed for Pearson/RMSE and mean profile metrics
contract.population: fixed supplied test regions; no filtering on target/prediction quality
contract.uncertainty: conditional on trained checkpoint; excludes training seed/assay uncertainty

bootstrap.unit: genomic bins merged if 2114bp input windows overlap; resampled within chromosome
bootstrap.warning: Chromosomes with one block contribute no within-chromosome resampling variation
